decision: Tracker adapter contract for epic/story/ticket creation and credential names
inferred: Azure parent link = relations add System.LinkTypes.Hierarchy-Reverse; verify on the work-item update page at build time
question: How do GitHub, Jira Cloud, and Azure DevOps create issues, parent links, and authenticate?
unknown: Jira issue type ids per project must be looked up at runtime via createmeta
verified: Jira Cloud: POST /rest/api/3/issue with fields.project, fields.issuetype, fields.summary, fields.parent.key; auth = Basic base64(email:api_token)
Azure DevOps: POST https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_apis/wit/workitems/${type}?api-version=7.1 with JSON Patch body adding /fields/System.Title; auth = Basic with empty username and PAT
